answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock real capital to transact, so spinning up a gale of throwaway identities becomes expensive instead of free. Honest agents build reputation that compounds, while a sybil swarm sees its forged bonds spiral into slashed losses the moment peers catch misbehavior. A public attestation ledger then acts as a beacon, letting counterparties verify stake and track record before trusting anyone.
